title: Runta, which provides isolated sandboxes and guardrails for AI agents to prevent operational risks, raised a $20M seed led by a16z at a $100M+ valuation (Stephanie Palazzolo/The Information)
summary: Stephanie Palazzolo / The Information: Runta, which provides isolated sandboxes and guardrails for AI agents to prevent operational risks, raised a $20M seed led by a16z at a $100M+ valuation — As a father to two young kids, Guanlan Dai sees a lot of similarities between AI agents and precocious children.
